verdict.rationale: Porkbun documents end-to-end flows that put a site on a domain when the site is hosted on Porkbun itself: Secure Static Hosting and a managed Cloud for WordPress site, both provisioned on the domain via the API. The evidence shows no connect templates or one-click connect for third-party hosts and platforms, which is the core of the story. Generic DNS record CRUD is only a building block and earns no credit. The Cloudflare move is a DNS-provider handover, not a site connection. missing for 10: one-click or template connect for major external hosts and platforms, a guided dashboard flow for pointing a domain at a site, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, connecting the domain to where my site lives is one guided step — templates or one-click connect for the major hosts and platforms

citations.quote: Provision and deploy Secure Static Hosting for a domain — create hosting (15-day free trial, one per domain), upload site files, and serve a static site over HTTPS, entirely via the API
Provision a managed **WordPress** site (Cloud for WordPress) on a domain, then mint WordPress REST API credentials so an agent can publish and manage content on it — end to end, no dashboard
